lessons: A Codex clean receipt on a new head does not close an earlier P1 thread; the machine needs the thread's state.
A fix parked behind the PR it unblocks is a deadlock the machine can detect: open FIX on the PR, the fix on a branch whose landing waits on that PR.
A sha that GET commits/<sha> cannot find is not pushed and has no proof, whatever the mail says.
A scope BLOCK (protected change on a feed branch) is the owner's to split, with no ruling needed.
